result.notes: Vonage (formerly Nexmo) is a large communications platform (Voice, SMS, Messages, Verify, Video, Number Insight, Conversation, Application APIs, etc.) — apis.guru only indexed the small "account" sub-API (3 endpoints), so api_breadth is judged large based on the full product surface, not that one spec. Auth is primarily API key/secret via HTTP Basic, plus JWT (Bearer) for Voice/Video/Application-scoped APIs; some legacy endpoints (e.g. SMS) accept api_key/api_secret as signed request params. Free developer account with starter credit is self-serve (no approval gate); production use is pay-as-you-go. Vonage publishes an official Documentation MCP server and an official API-bindings MCP server (community forks/alternatives also exist, e.g. khan2a/telephony-mcp-server), so mcp.status is official rather than community.
result.one_liner: Vonage is a cloud communications platform (CPaaS) providing REST APIs for SMS, Voice, Video, Messages, Verify, and Number Insight.
